notes: SHIP v1.14.463 - PASTE ANYTHING: ONE DOOR THAT DOES NOT MAKE THE TECHNICIAN NAME THE FORMAT FIRST. WHAT IT DOES. A technician pastes whatever is on the clipboard - a port map, a rack elevation, CLI output, a BOM CSV or a vendor EDP - into a single box. PHANTOM says which of the five it looks like, offers ONE route, and on tap opens that parser WITH THE TEXT ALREADY IN IT. The paste happens once. IT CLASSIFIES, IT NEVER PARSES. paste_classify reads shape only and returns a verdict plus a caption; it does not interpret a single field. Every one of the five parsers keeps the exact door it already had - portmap, rackmap and bom through rd_openOpsTool, cli through goCliParser and vendor EDP through vendorEdp_open. No parser was modified, no second engine was added, and no existing route was removed. DETECTION IS DETERMINISTIC AND OFFLINE. Same text in, same verdict out, every time. No model, no network, no scoring shown to the technician. It reads the opening 200 lines or 32 KB, because every format here is identifiable from its head. TIES AND LOW CONFIDENCE RETURN UNKNOWN, ON PURPOSE. A confident wrong verdict wastes the paste and teaches a technician not to trust the door, so the classifier must beat a floor AND beat the runner-up by a margin. Unknown is not a failure state: it says so plainly and offers the full tool list, which is exactly what the technician does today, so this door is never worse than no door. STRUCTURE DECIDES, NOT VOCABULARY. This was rebuilt after three rounds of the same defect class. Keyword rules cannot separate technician prose from technical output, because prose can always contain the keywords - and every narrowing that closed a prose hole also started refusing REAL pastes, such as a port map with a comment banner above the header or a CLI echo behind a capture timestamp. Real pastes are line-oriented, repetitive and delimited; prose is sentences. A structural gate now runs ahead of all format scoring and carries the false-positive load, which lets the format rules stay generous enough to accept messy real data. A lone sentence cannot classify however many trigger words it holds. SOP IS EXCLUDED, DELIBERATELY. Anything at all is valid SOP text, so an SOP verdict could never be wrong and could never be right - it would swallow every ambiguous paste and turn unknown into a guess wearing a label. VENDOR EDP UNDER-CLAIMS ON PURPOSE. EDP is prose plus tables and has the weakest shape signal of the five. It requires the full phrase equipment data pack AND a document's worth of document-field lines; the acronym alone, the phrase alone, or the phrase with a single field is a status note ABOUT an EDP, not an EDP. THE ROUTER CANNOT LOSE A PASTE. One pending slot, consumed once, cleared before every early return, so no path leaves a second answer to what the technician is working on. A target may DECLINE - vendor EDP needs an active deployment because vendorEdp_open never creates one - and a decline is audible, keeps the sheet open and keeps the text. The write into the destination box is verified rather than assumed, because writing into a missing or hidden node succeeds silently and looks broken on screen. If a box already held hand-entered text the overwrite is announced rather than done in silence. WHERE THE DOOR IS. A PASTE ANYTHING row on Work, rendered inside the Build workspace, above its three routing branches so it exists even with no Master loaded - classifying a paste needs no Master. It is not a tenth ops-cell: the OPS wall is a 3 by 3 of exactly nine whose own banner reads Nine tools on this build. GATES: three-stamp lockstep at .463, inline blocks compile, node --check sw.js, valid JSON, brace balance, 0 bare LF, 0 mojibake. VERIFIED ON PHONE-WEBKIT, THE PRIMARY GATE: 42-paste-classifier 6, 43-paste-door 12, 03-tools 28, 01-nav 14. ⚠ A NOTE ON A STALE CLAIM, recorded rather than quietly dropped: the session ledger carried phone-webkit as down machine-wide on a libegl.dll error, and that was inherited and repeated before it was retested. It launches and runs green. Nothing was gated on chromium in the end, but the claim had already been written into commit messages, which is why it is corrected here in the shipped record. DEVICE-VERIFY: paste a real port map from your notes and confirm it names the format and lands you in PORT MAP with the text already there; then paste an ordinary note and confirm it says it does not recognise it instead of guessing.
